items.text: Emeka Egbuka listed OUT (concussion/foot) on Sunday injury board.
items.why: Final injury report; cleared concussion but foot keeps him out.
items.implication: TB WR depth thinned; look to other Bucs pass-catchers if any.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining TB WRs.
More looks for Ridley (Q) or others.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT; Dontayvion Wicks OUT. Saquon Barkley IN/no designation.
items.implication: PHI WR vacuum; Barkley plays despite prior hamstring/back.
items.opportunity: More targets to Goedert/other WRs; Barkley full role expected but not 100%.

items.text: RJ Harvey OUT (knee); Jaylen Waddle QUESTIONABLE (chest).
items.implication: Harvey unique role hard to replace; 3-6 extra targets available; Waddle uncertain.
items.opportunity: Targets to Waddle if plays or other DEN pass-catchers; Coleman/Dobbins backfield.

items.text: Lamar Jackson IN (no designation after ankle).
items.why: Not on final report; full practices.
items.implication: Ravens offense unlocked; small dock on rushing.
items.opportunity: Boost to Flowers and Ravens pass-catchers.

items.text: Colts open to trading Jonathan Taylor; multiple teams inquired, talks active. No way Jets trade Garrett Wilson.
items.implication: JT landing spot TBD; monitor deadline. Wilson stays.

items.text: Notes on ETR board: Meyers weird (LP-LP-DNP) could mean season-high routes for Travis Hunter given BTJ tier drop. Harvey unique no clean replacement but 3-6 targets free; Waddle Q. Lamar small rushing docks. Breece cryptic + rumors. Shocked Barkley not on report (plays but not 100%). Moore/Kincaid no FP after bye.
items.implication: Hunter routes up; DEN targets redistribute; caution on Lamar rush/Barkley health/Breece.
items.opportunity: Hunter routes; free targets DEN; Braelon if Hall out.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); cryptic social post + trade rumors.
items.why: Another Q tag; was close last week.

items.text: AJ Brown QUESTIONABLE (knee); ETR took him OUT in early projs.
items.implication: NE WR risk; fallout in projs.
items.opportunity: If out, more to other Pats.

items.text: After two-TD outing, try to sell Quinshon Judkins (role hit with Sampson back).
items.why: Snap/target share lows with Sampson return (from 13.6% targets prior).

items.text: Taken Egbuka (conc/foot), Tate (shoulder), Spears (knee), AJ Brown (knee) OUT in projs; view fallout there. BTJ now in low tier after 87-1282-10 rookie.
items.implication: Projection drops for outs; BTJ tier freefall.

items.text: LOVE Zay Flowers @BUF as WR5; Lamar unlock + track-meet game.
HATE Jaylen Waddle vs KC (production lacking; KC allows 1 WR TD all year). LOVE Derrick Henry @BUF (RB6), Chase Brown vs TEN (RB8), Josh Jacobs vs CAR (RB11). HATE Barkley @WSH, Pollard, Hampton.
items.why: Matchups vs weak run Ds for loves; tough WR Ds and usage concerns for hates.
items.implication: Start Henry/Brown/Jacobs; fade Waddle/Barkley et al.

items.text: Fact: Loveland 30% target share/19.2 PPG/top-5 TE both weeks since Caleb return. Judkins role hit (season-low snaps/targets) with Sampson back (prior 13.6% tgt w/o). Also Burrow/Lawrence QB loves.
items.implication: Loveland TE1; Judkins sell/ downgrade pass work; start Burrow/Lawrence.
